newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish paper firm Celuloza sale after Apr 25 - min.
newsitem.headline: Polish paper firm Celuloza sale after Apr 25 - min.

text.p: The treasury ministry is likely to sell a 65 percent stake of Poland's largest paper maker Celuloza SA to South Africa's Mondi soon after the firm's bourse debut on April 25, the treasury ministry said on Monday.
"We will try to finalise this transaction soon after the company's first listing on April 25," deputy treasury minister Piotr Czyzewski told reporters at a seminar.

He confirmed that a consortium led by Mondi, a unit of Anglo-American Corp of South Africa, and its Austrian subsidiary Frantschach AG had won the right to be the sole bidder in the Celuloza privatisation tender.

The treasury ministry offered 15 percent or 7.5 million shares of Celuloza in a public subscription at a minimum price of 15 zlotys and the final strike price will be determined and shares allotted at a special bourse session on April 22.
